Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 2646 of 2023
Applicant :- Anupam Goel
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Station In Charge Office Lko.

Rural Counsel for Applicant :- Amarjeet Singh Rakhra,Bashisth Muni Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.
Heard Sri Amar Jeet Singh Rakhra, the learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Anurag Verma, the learned AGA-I for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed by the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in an FIR bearing Case Crime No. 27/2021, under Sections 409, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B IPC, Police Station SIT,
District Lucknow Rural.

entities.text:
Police Station SIT,
District Lucknow Rural
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an FIR lodged on 20.07.2021 against 14 sets of persons.

The eight set of accused persons implicated in the FIR is 'Anupam Goyal, Secretary and other officers and employees' and the address mentioned against second set of accused persons is 'Institute of Professional Excellence and Management, Gaziabad, U.P. Bharat.'
4.

entities.text: Institute of Professional Excellence and Management, Gaziabad
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The allegation levelled in the FIR is that in furtherance of a complaint dated 19.06.2019, a special Anupam Goel vs State Of U.P. Thru. Station In Charge ... on 18 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198796837/

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 investigation team was constituted which conducted an inquiry and submitted a report to a committee constituted by the Government.

During inquiry, it came to light that although the complaint alleged embezzlement of Rs. 200 crore in payment of scholarships to students belonging to Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe categories, merely Rs. 58 crores has been drawn by the concerned institute towards payment of scholarships.
5. The FIR does not disclosed commission of any act by the applicant, which may amount to commission of an offence.

6. In para 12 of the affidavit filed in support of the application, it has been stated that the applicant is the Secretary of Society/Institute of Professional Excellence and Management Ghaziabad, and he has no concern with the working of the selection committee, who had inducted students for PGDM course and he was not involved in day to day running of the institute.
It has further been stated that the applicant does not draw any monetary benefits either from the society or from the institution.

7. The learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that the FIR in question was lodged on 20.07.2021, the applicant had cooperated with the investigation and has got his statement recorded by the Investigating Officer and even after expiry of more than two years, the investigation is still going on and charge sheet is yet to be submitted.
8.

Three co-accused persons have already granted anticipatory bail in the present case and copies of their bail orders have been annexed as Annexure Nos. 8 & 9 of the affidavit filed in support of the application.

Co-accused-Kunwar Pal Singh has also been granted anticipatory bail by this court by means of the order dated 17.10.2023 passed in CRIMINAL MISC ANTICIPATORY BAIL APPLICATION U/S 438 CR.P.C. No.2268 of 2023.

9. Sri Anurag Verma, learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the bail application and on the basis of instruction, he has submitted that it has come to light during investigation that the institution in question had shown various admission of students in PGDM course during the year 2013-2017 and in connivance with the officers/officials of the Social Welfare Department Ghaziabad, Government money was embezzled in the name of payment of scholarship to the students.

10. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, coupled with the fact that the applicant has no criminal history, he has cooperated with the investigation and four co-accused persons have already been granted anticipatory bail in the present case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for granting anticipatory bail to the applicant.
11. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.

In the event of arrest/ appearance of applicant-Anupam Goel before the learned Trial Court in the aforesaid case,
he shall be released on anticipatory bail on his furnishing personal bond and two solvent sureties,
each in the like amount, to the satisfaction of S.H.O./Court concerned on the following conditions and subject to any other conditions that may be fixed by the Trial Court:
Anupam Goel vs State Of U.P. Thru. Station In Charge ... on 18 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/198796837/
